puṇṇikā.p: [ puṇṇā + ka + ā ] (thī) CL=10 (1) The female slave named Puṇṇā. (Pyī, sya. 387.) (2) The female slave named Puṇṇikā. (3) The nun named puṇṇikā.

puṇṇiya.p: [ adhiccasamuppannanāma ] (pu) CL=10 The elder named Puṇṇiya.
pn: Puṇṇiya. A monk. He is mentioned as visiting the Buddha and asking him under what conditions a sermon presents itself to the mind of a Tathāgata. AN.iv.337f.; v.154f.
